title: interlock-week-okr-draft-and-townline-runbook-v0-1
content:
Purpose: rapid, cross-functional alignment ahead of the Q3 interlock week. This doc is the working slate for the OKR draft we'll present to leadership, plus the townline facilitation notes for the company-level sync.

What this doc is NOT: final okrs. It's an adaptive runbook to collect tradeoffs, decision owners, and speaking order for the all-hands rehearsal.

Meeting goals (interlock week):
- Surface conflicts across product + infra + go-to-market scope that block Q3 launches.
- Lock top 3 measurable company objectives with proposed owners and metrics.
- Agree on escalation paths for capacity and security asks for Private deployments.
- Rehearse a 15-minute exec update segment + 30-minute town Q&A flow.

Draft company-level objectives (working)
1) Objective: Make inference predictable and 3x more cost-efficient for mid-market workloads by EOY.
   - Key result A: 30% reduction in median per-token cost on common telemetry 50th percentile traffic (baseline = Jan 2026).
   - Key result B: Shipping Redwood Optimize first recommendations (batching + quantization profiles) to 3 pilot customers with measured cost regression tests.
   - Proposed owner: Evelyn Chen (Product: Optimize)
   - Open questions: What SLA or latency delta tolerances do we accept for the 30% cost target?

2) Objective: Deliver Dedicated GA with SLOs and self-serve reservation flow for small enterprise customers.
   - Key result A: GA feature set complete and documented (billing, quotas, autoscale) by end of Q3 beta window.
   - Key result B: Onboard 5 pilot customers, each with acceptance test pass rate > 90%.
   - Proposed owner: Diego Morales (Dedicated Product Lead)
   - Dependency: infra capacity commit (SRE) and billing integration (Finance).

3) Objective: Enterprise controls for Private deployments — security/hardening and audit readiness.
   - Key result A: KMS/HSM integration validated with two partners and automated rotation docs.
   - Key result B: Audit playbook + 2 SOC readiness runbooks published internally and validated in tabletop.
   - Proposed owner: Samir Rao (Security & Compliance)
   - Risk note: On‑prem packaging timeline depends on release-engineering resource slots.

Risks and tradeoffs (brief):
- Pursuing aggressive cost reductions may require more conservative rollout for latency-sensitive customers. Decision: default to preserving latency SLAs for Hosted API tier.
- Dedicated GA push increases demand on infra + release-engineering concurrently with a Private deployment pilot. Consider shifting low-risk infra migration tasks to Q4 if pilot capacity is tight.

Exec update (15-minute run-of-show)
- 0:00–0:02 Opening: CEO frame on why serving-first thesis matters now (2 min) — catalog of wins from last quarter (throughput improvements, cost per token gains).
- 0:02–0:07 Product highlights (5 min): Evelyn — Optimize pilot status, initial numbers, ask for pilot expansion. (include one slide with cost waterfall).
- 0:07–0:11 Dedicated GA status (4 min): Diego — rollout plan, pilot customer highlights, blockers.
- 0:11–0:15 Security and Private (4 min): Samir — audit roadmap + immediate asks for resources.

Townline facilitation (30-minute)
- 0–5 min: Quick pulse (poll in Slack #all-staff) — which of the three objectives matters most to your team?
- 5–15 min: Lightning breakouts (5 groups by function) to surface 2 blockers each.
- 15–25 min: Reportouts + decision tick (we'll mark items that require leadership arbitration).
- 25–30 min: Close and next steps + where to vote on tradeoffs (Confluence page + Loom).

Prework for presenters (checklist):
- Slides: 3‑slide max per presenter (problem, progress, ask).
- Data: include one graph per KR showing baseline and delta. Data owners: Analytics (ticket CORE-1423).
- Runbook: Provide escalation contacts for infra capacity and on-call windows.
- Rehearsal: 1 dry run scheduled 2 days before town (schedule in calendar).

Open action items (assignments)
- Evelyn: finalize Optimize pilot dashboard and add cost waterfall by 2026-03-05. (ASSIGNED)
- Diego: confirm Dedicated GA capacity map and pilot onboarding checklist by 2026-03-08. (ASSIGNED)
- Samir: publish audit tabletop scope and invite list by 2026-03-09. (ASSIGNED)
- Morgan: compile townline facilitation kit (poll, breakout prompts) and publish to Confluence by 2026-03-04. (ASSIGNED)

Decision log (working)
- Decision 1: Default latency floor for hosted API remains <= 150ms p50. (proposed)
- Decision 2: Cost-first optimizations will be opt-in per customer for the next 2 quarters; no automatic application. (proposed)

Outstanding questions for leadership
- Prioritization: If we cannot achieve both Dedicated GA and the Private pilot in Q3, which should we shift? Need leadership guidance by 2026-03-12.
- Budget: Is there runway to add two release-engineering contractors to accelerate Private bundling? Provide rough cost ceiling.

Appendix / artifacts to review before interlock week
- Confluence: /company/quarterly-interlock/agenda (link above)
- Data dashboard: analytics.redwood/internal/okr-q3-2026 (access request via Slack #data-ops)
- Related tickets: JIRA CORE-1423, INFRA-2301, SEC-98

Notes to self / drafting fragments:
- Keep language crisp: avoid product jargon in exec slides — translate to customer outcomes (cost per seat, SLOs).
- Add two customer anecdotes for Dedicated pilot slide (ask solutions-engineering to prepare).
- Consider a short 60–90s video snippet from an engineering lead showing the performance improvements — humanizes the metric.

Versioning: v0-1 (working). Next step: collect feedback from cross-functional leads by EOD 2026-03-06, produce v0-2 with updated KRs and clearer owner RACI.

Contact: Morgan Patel (Morgan.p@redwood.ai) — ping for sync or to add items to the decision backlog.
